module_title: Functional Infrastructure Matrix - Testing, Launching, and Production Hubs
introduction: This level maps out the primary hardware-assembly labs, testing arrays, and execution sites across India. State PCS and RO/ARO papers heavily feature these locations in matching-pair questions.

core_concepts.title: ISRO Core Launch & Assembly Nodes
core_concepts.description:
- **VSSC (Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre)**: Located in **Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala**. This is ISRO's absolute anchor for launch vehicle (rocket) design, including the PSLV, GSLV, and SSLV series.
- **URSC (U R Rao Satellite Centre)**: Located in **बेंगलुरु (Bengaluru)**. Formerly known as ISAC, this node serves as the primary hub for the conception, design, fabrication, and testing of all Indian satellites.
- **SAC (Space Applications Centre)**: Located in **Ahmedabad, Gujarat**. Focuses on developing practical space-sensor payloads, tele-education frameworks, and satellite communication systems.

core_concepts.title: ISRO Command, Control, and Flight Facilities
core_concepts.description:
- **SDSC (Satish Dhawan Space Centre - SHAR)**: Located on **Sriharikota Island, Andhra Pradesh**. This is India's principal spaceport and orbital launch base.
- **MCF (Master Control Facility)**: Located at **Hassan (Karnataka)** and **Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh)**. Responsible for post-launch orbital maneuvers, geostationary satellite tracking, and in-orbit health monitoring.

core_concepts.title: DRDO Strategic Laboratories & Heavy Engineering Units
core_concepts.description:
- **DRDL (Defence Research and Development Laboratory)**: Located in **Hyderabad, Telangana**. The central powerhouse for India's missile systems engineering and flight dynamics design.
- **ARDE (Armament Research & Development Establishment)**: Located in **Pune, Maharashtra**. Focuses on conventional weapons development, small arms, and advanced artillery ammunition.
- **CVRDE (Combat Vehicles Research and Development Establishment)**: Located in **Avadi, Chennai**. Specializes in tracked armored vehicles, famously executing the indigenous **Arjun Main Battle Tank (MBT)** project.

important_entities.name: The Geography of Sriharikota
important_entities.significance: Geographically, the Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SHAR) sits on a spindle-shaped island in Andhra Pradesh that acts as a natural spit or barrier separating the **Pulicat Lake** from the Bay of Bengal. This cross-domain link makes it a popular question in combined Geography-Science papers.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.alert_title: The Rocket vs. Satellite Assembly Swapping Trap
trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: In match-the-following columns, examiners intentionally switch VSSC and URSC. Keep a firm distinction: **Rockets/Launch Vehicles** are built at **VSSC Thiruvananthapuram**, whereas actual **Satellites/Payloads** are assembled at **URSC Bengaluru**.

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: Missiles find their haven in Hyderabad.
mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Most top-tier DRDO labs focused on advanced rocketry, missile guidance, and avionics (like DRDL, RCI, and ASL) are clustered tightly inside Hyderabad. Use this to make educated guesses in complex lists.

exam_strategy_tips: Note the dual setup of the Master Control Facility (MCF). If an exam question asks for MCF locations, it must include both Hassan and Bhopal; overlooking the Bhopal wing is a common error.
